title: Steel Chevaliere - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Steel Chevaliere in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Weak to Physical rather than to an element, which makes it one of the few enemies where a physical build is the correct specialist answer.

sections.title: Where to Find the Steel Chevaliere
How to Beat the Steel Chevaliere
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Physical is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.
